title: Learned Selector Observability Under Adversarial Evidence and Independent Corroboration
scientific_question: Can a learned selector using the same policy-visible state as Study-2 S1 overcome the V5 signed-but-false observability limit, and what changes when genuinely independent corroboration becomes policy-visible?

learner.tie_break: minimum training error, then minimum absolute weight sum, then threshold and weights lexicographically

A_VISIBLE_LATTICE.description: all 2^8 policy-visible states with hidden authorization equal to visible authorization, evaluated by D0 and L0

B_CORROBORATION_LATTICE.description: all 2^9 extended visible states, with hidden authorization equal to visible authorization, evaluated by L1

C_HIDDEN_TRUTH_COLLISION.description: three hidden-truth scenarios sharing the same eight-feature base vector, crossed with all three policies
